newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tsubakimoto says rogue deals cost it 1.2 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Tsubakimoto says rogue deals cost it 1.2 bln yen.

text.p: Tsubakimoto Machinery & Engineering Co Ltd said on Wednesday it will incur damages totalling an estimated 1.2 billion yen due to unauthorised transactions by a former employee.
The estimate may be revised, however, as a result of further investigations, the company said in a statement.
The company said the unauthorised transactions involved a Tsubakimoto customer for plastic molding machinery. It did not offer any additional details on the case.
Tsubakimoto said earlier on Wednesday that it lowered its earnings forecast for the year to March 31, 1997 due to damage from the unauthorised deals.
It now expects a parent net loss of 880 million yen in 1996/97, compared with its previous forecast of a net profit of 350 million yen.
In 1995/96, the company posted a net profit of 300 million yen.
